info.title: Open Print Stack
info.description: The Open Print Stack server's REST API. Generated from the server's routes; don't edit it by hand. Errors are ApiError bodies whose code says what went wrong.

post.description: Sets the ops_session cookie. After 5 failed logins from one address, each further failure makes it wait (1 s, doubling to 5 min), during which logins answer 429.

put.summary: Upload a file to a printer
put.description: The body is the file itself, with a Content-Length (chunked uploads get 411). The printer's file types, state and size limit are checked before the body is read. A file of the same name is replaced. Publishes command.requested and command.result for the file.upload command.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: The file's name on the printer: 1–255 bytes in UTF-8, with no /, \ or control characters, and not . or ... Percent-encode it in the path.

CommandResult.description: The command succeeded. A refused or failed command answers with an ApiError instead, whose details are { commandId, durationMs } once the command has been requested.

settingsSchema.description: The settings' JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), describing the input: fields with a default are optional and carry it.

defaults.description: The default of each settings field that has one.

nextCursor.description: The `before` for the next, older page; null when there's nothing older.

users.description: The username of each user these events name, by id. A deleted user isn't here.

name.description: 1–64 characters after trimming, with no control characters. Unique, ignoring the case of A–Z.

settings.description: Settings fields, checked against the driver type's settings schema.

PrinterConfig.description: A printer's stored config. Settings are stored with every default filled in.

name.description: 1–64 characters after trimming, with no control characters. Unique, ignoring the case of A–Z.

settings.description: Fields to change; the rest keep their stored values. Changing settings restarts the driver, and is refused (409 job_active) while a job is active.

username.description: 1–32 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, after trimming. Matched ignoring case.

password.description: 12–1024 characters (Unicode code points), counted after NFKC normalisation. Spaces count and nothing is trimmed.

UserCommand.description: Any command except file.upload, which only uploads create.

session.name: ops_session
session.description: The session cookie that setup and login set: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 7 days from the last request.
